category_edits.rationale: Anchor positions to recency across all four category models: the rightmost occupied position receives ID 1, preceding occupied positions receive increasing IDs, and padding remains 0. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so appended-mask inference uses the identical position construction without changing checkpoint shapes.

change_summary: Replace chronological position IDs with reverse nonpadding recency ranks. Preserve history truncation, masked training, final-mask readout, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer, and dataset routing.
